description: A fictional company building software for industrial heat pump planning.
climateProblem: Industrial sites waste energy because heat demand and equipment options are hard to compare.
solutionDescription: The product models site-level heat demand and recommends lower-carbon retrofit options.
businessModel: Annual software licence for industrial operators and engineering consultancies.
targetMarket: UK and European manufacturers with high process heat demand.
competitors: Internal spreadsheets, engineering consultancy reports and generic energy modelling tools.
tweetPitch: Planning software for industrial heat pump retrofits.
tractionSummary: Twelve paid sites now use the product, including three multi-site industrial groups.
unfairAdvantage: The team combines heat system modelling, site delivery experience and operating data from paid deployments.
